findings.current: her black eyes remained fixed on the hill below.
findings.defect: The Korean says her eyes had been fixed on the hill below all along (줄곧 그래왔듯이). The assembled version drops that continuity detail, which the accepted baseline preserves.
findings.rationale: 줄곧 그래왔듯이 explicitly marks the ongoing, established direction of her gaze.
findings.replacement: her black eyes remained fixed on the hill below, as they always had.

findings.current: one of the absolute one’s closest confidantes
findings.defect: “Confidantes” specifies a female confidant, but the Korean only identifies this woman as one of the absolute one’s closest associates; it does not specify the associate’s gender.
findings.rationale: 최측근 중 하나 establishes closeness and status, not the associate’s gender.
findings.replacement: one of the absolute one’s closest confidants

findings.current: No sooner had it reached his hand than it shot out in a flash.
findings.defect: This states as fact that the spear reached his hand before shooting out. The Korean immediately qualifies the apparent retrieval: the instant it seemed to happen, the spear shot away. The accepted baseline preserves that momentary perception.
findings.rationale: 그랬다고 느낀 순간 makes the retrieval a perception at the moment of the spear’s sudden launch, not an unequivocal completed pause before it.
findings.replacement: No—the instant it seemed to reach his hand, it shot out in a flash.

summary: The assembled English is faithful overall, with a few minor omissions or added implications compared with the Korean and accepted baseline.
